blocks.heading_path: Electronics Returns Policy > Electronics Returns Policy
blocks.text: This policy covers returns of televisions, computers, tablets, phones, cameras, and other electronic devices purchased from Walmart, whether in-store or online.
blocks.html:
Electronics Returns Policy

This policy covers returns of televisions, computers, tablets, phones, cameras, and other electronic devices purchased from Walmart, whether in-store or online.

blocks.text: Electronics may be returned within 30 days of purchase with the original receipt or proof of purchase. Items must be unopened, or include all original accessories, cables, and packaging. Items showing signs of physical damage not present at time of sale are not eligible for return.
blocks.html:
Eligibility

Electronics may be returned within 30 days of purchase with the original receipt or proof of purchase. Items must be unopened, or include all original accessories, cables, and packaging. Items showing signs of physical damage not present at time of sale are not eligible for return.

blocks.heading_path: Electronics Returns Policy > High-value items without a receipt
blocks.text: If the item exceeds $500 in value and the customer does not have a receipt or other proof of purchase, do not process the return at the register.
blocks.html:
High-value items without a receipt

If the item exceeds $500 in value and the customer does not have a receipt or other proof of purchase, do not process the return at the register.

blocks.heading_path: Electronics Returns Policy > High-value items without a receipt
blocks.text: Escalate to a Returns Specialist for manual verification.
blocks.html:
High-value items without a receipt

Escalate to a Returns Specialist for manual verification.

blocks.text: No restocking fee applies to electronics returned within the eligibility window in original condition.
blocks.html:
Restocking Fees

No restocking fee applies to electronics returned within the eligibility window in original condition.

blocks.heading_path: SOP: Processing Electronics Returns > SOP: Processing Electronics Returns
blocks.text: Use this procedure at the register or customer service desk when a customer requests to return an electronics item. See the Electronics Returns Policy for eligibility rules.
blocks.html:
SOP: Processing Electronics Returns

Use this procedure at the register or customer service desk when a customer requests to return an electronics item. See the Electronics Returns Policy for eligibility rules.

blocks.text: Steps for processing an electronics return at the register or customer service desk.
blocks.html:
Procedure

Steps for processing an electronics return at the register or customer service desk.

blocks.text: Look up the order or verify the receipt, and confirm the purchase date is within the eligibility window.
blocks.html:
Step 1

Look up the order or verify the receipt, and confirm the purchase date is within the eligibility window.

blocks.text: Inspect the item for completeness: original packaging, cables, and accessories.
blocks.html:
Step 2

Inspect the item for completeness: original packaging, cables, and accessories.

blocks.text: Confirm the item shows no signs of damage beyond normal wear.
blocks.html:
Step 3

Confirm the item shows no signs of damage beyond normal wear.

blocks.text: If eligible, process the return in the POS system and issue the refund to the original payment method.
blocks.html:
Step 4

If eligible, process the return in the POS system and issue the refund to the original payment method.

blocks.text: If the item exceeds $500 in value and the customer has no receipt or other proof of purchase, do not process the return at the register.
blocks.html:
Exception

If the item exceeds $500 in value and the customer has no receipt or other proof of purchase, do not process the return at the register.

blocks.text: Escalate to the Returns Specialist queue via the Associate Support Tool, case type High-Value No-Receipt Return. Provide the item description, estimated value, and reason the customer could not produce a receipt.
blocks.html:
Escalation

Escalate to the Returns Specialist queue via the Associate Support Tool, case type High-Value No-Receipt Return. Provide the item description, estimated value, and reason the customer could not produce a receipt.

blocks.heading_path: Electronics Accessories Return Window > Electronics Accessories Return Window
blocks.text: This policy addresses returns of electronics accessories including cables, chargers, cases, and headphones purchased alongside or separately from a primary electronics device.
blocks.html:
Electronics Accessories Return Window

This policy addresses returns of electronics accessories including cables, chargers, cases, and headphones purchased alongside or separately from a primary electronics device.

blocks.text: Electronics accessories may be returned within 30 days of purchase with proof of purchase, in unused condition with original packaging.
blocks.html:
Eligibility

Electronics accessories may be returned within 30 days of purchase with proof of purchase, in unused condition with original packaging.
